**Update: Skates P8 now updates itself**

Short version: from this version on the app looks for a new version every time it starts and installs it by itself. You have to install this one by hand, one last time.

## New

**The app updates itself**
- When you start the app and a new version is out, it downloads it, installs it and starts again. It takes about a minute and you do not have to click anything.

## Good to know

- Versions 6.0.0.0 to 6.0.3.0 do not update themselves. Download **SkatesP8_Setup.exe** from skated2r.com/p8 (or from your page when you are signed in) and run it once. Your settings and hotkeys stay.
- The app restarts by itself right after the update. Your game windows are not closed.

Tickets and feedback are always welcome. Use **REQUEST FEATURE** in the top bar.
